aboutGame.title: What is The Forgotten Island V1 0?
paragraphs: The Forgotten Island V1 0 is a compact, free-to-play open-world RPG from developer Thomas Chia and publisher TumbleweedGameDesign. You open an ancient scroll, wake up on a low-poly medieval island full of merchants and villagers, and learn that your only real objective is finding a way back to the real world.

Progression runs on turn-based duels and talent points rather than reflexes. Every level is cleared by finishing the tasks you are given, while farming, fishing, eating, and drinking keep vitality and stamina high enough to survive the next fight. It is short, objective-driven, and runs smoothly on modest hardware.

modules.name: The Forgotten Island V1 0 Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly guide covering basic controls, survival priorities, exploration tips, and the first steps players need after arriving on the island. It helps new players understand movement, resource management, NPC interactions, and early progression.

highlights.detail: Adjust your settings first, then learn the two core inputs: hold E beside wells, food, and beds, and hold F beside an NPC to start a duel.
Drink water and eat food until vitality and stamina are full before you walk away from the starting village.
Explore the opening area completely and read every note and dialogue line, because objectives can update without a prompt.
Follow the developer's Santa mission walkthrough on the Steam community hub when you hit the first real difficulty spike.
Save manually in a separate slot before committing to a long expedition so a bad fight never costs you an hour.

modules.name: The Forgotten Island V1 0 Walkthrough
modules.description: A complete walkthrough section covering missions, exploration routes, important objectives, and progression checkpoints. This module can organize official walkthrough videos and gameplay solutions into searchable guides.

highlights.detail: Survive the first hour by stocking water and food, then fight only when your stamina bar is full.
Learn the combat loop: light and heavy attacks drain stamina, defend is free, and relax restores stamina but leaves you open.
Spend talent points into one primary attribute so your character scales instead of stalling at every tier.
Fund the run through farming, fishing, and merchant trading before pushing into tougher map tiers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about The Forgotten Island V1 0.

items.question: What is The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: The Forgotten Island V1 0 is a free-to-play open-world RPG on Steam from developer Thomas Chia and publisher TumbleweedGameDesign. You open an ancient scroll, wake on a low-poly medieval island, and work through tasks, duels, and merchant trading until you find a way back to the real world.

items.question: How do you survive your first hour in The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: Drink water and eat food until vitality and stamina are full, learn that holding E uses wells, food, and beds, and never start a duel with an empty stamina bar. The game hands you very little, so treat every trip away from the village as a costed expedition.

items.question: What do talent points do in The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: Each talent point gives fixed bonuses: 1 Strength adds +120 Vitality and +50 Stamina, 1 Agility adds +5 Attack and +2 Armor, and 1 Intelligence adds +20 Crit, +20 Avoid, and +40 Lucky. Commit to one primary attribute early so your build actually scales.

items.question: How do you make money in The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: Farming, fishing, and merchant trading are the low-risk income loop. Keep one plot growing, fish while your crops mature, and sell surplus goods to merchants, then reinvest the coin into sustain upgrades before raw damage.

items.question: Where is the Santa mission in The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: The Santa mission is the centerpiece of the developer's first walkthrough thread on the Steam community hub, posted under the name Thomas in September 2020. It is widely reported as the first real difficulty spike and the most commonly missed requirement for the finale.

items.question: How do you reach the ending in The Forgotten Island V1 0?
items.answer: The ending in The Forgotten Island V1 0 is not a selectable level. It unlocks once the game registers that every required story mission and objective is complete, so clear your mission log, confirm each objective registered, and save in a separate slot before you commit to the finale.
